title: LingoGlass AR WebSocket Events
description: Wire contract for /v1/sessions/{id}/stream. Each frame on the wire is a single JSON object matching one of the variants in oneOf. Client = mobile app, Server = FastAPI backend. Direction is recorded in each variant's description. Reconciled with the translator service implemented in S1 Day 2 (commit ab22deb): audio is PCM16 16 kHz mono and translated text is split into incremental deltas plus one final marker per utterance.

sessionStart.description: Client -> Server. First WS frame after the socket opens. Configures the translation direction and retention policy for this WS session. Server replies with sessionOpened. The sessionId itself was already allocated by POST /v1/sessions before the WS connect.

retainText.description: If true, server is allowed to keep translatedText in the session record for later /api/v1/sessions/{id}/events read. If false, text is forwarded then dropped.

audioChunk.description: Client -> Server. One audio frame of the current utterance. Codec is locked to raw PCM16 mono at 16 kHz (sampleRateHz=16000). Frame size is implementation choice; ~100 ms (3200 bytes raw, ~4.3 KB base64) is recommended per backend translator contract. seq starts at 0 and increments by 1 per chunk for this session.

audioEnd.description: Client -> Server. Signals end-of-utterance. Server closes its audio_frames iterator passed into Translator.translate_stream(), which triggers input_audio_buffer.commit + response.create. Server then starts emitting translationPartial / translationFinal frames. seq is the last audio.chunk seq + 1.

metrics.description: Client -> Server. Optional telemetry from the mobile latency logger (e.g. push-to-talk duration, mic-open ms). name is a free-form lower-snake-case key. valueMs is unsigned. Server may persist these into the session_events table.

sessionOpened.description: Server -> Client. Ack to session.start. Confirms sessionId is live and the server is ready for audio.chunk frames. Mobile starts its latency timer from this serverTs.

translationPartial.description: Server -> Client. One incremental chunk of translated text. Maps 1:1 to TextDelta(text=..., final=False) from app/services/translator.py. text is never empty for this variant; empty-text deltas (e.g. transcription-only updates) are not surfaced to the wire. Mobile renderer appends to a buffer and may paint progressively.

translationFinal.description: Server -> Client. Closes the current utterance. Maps to TextDelta(text='', final=True) from the translator. translatedText is the concatenation of every translation.partial chunk emitted in this utterance (server keeps the buffer; mobile may rely on this OR on its own concatenation). sourceText is populated iff OpenAI returned an input_audio_transcription.completed event; it is consumed only by the cost logger (Day 8) and MUST NOT be displayed to end users by default (privacy boundary per backend/CLAUDE.md). durationMs is server-measured from session.opened to this frame.

sourceText.description: Optional. Source-language transcription. Privacy-sensitive — see description above.

error.description: Server -> Client. Signals failure. retryable=true means mobile can reopen the WS and start a new session.start; retryable=false means abort and surface the error to the user. Recognised codes (extensible): translator_error (TranslatorError from translator service), upstream_unavailable (OpenAI WS down), session_not_found, daily_cap_exceeded, invalid_event (schema validation failed).
